cells.gaps: The 40.4 per cent counts rural households, not people; the World Bank's series gives 23.5 per cent of rural people for 2024. The latest figure is below 53.
cells.note: The latest figure, the statistics bureau's 40.4 per cent of rural households connected, cited in January 2026, is 27 or more and below 53, so stage 2. Under message 138 a figure from any source counts, not only the World Bank series.
